facts.fact: 日记日期为 2024 年 10 月 17 日
他把真名 Arthur 告诉了 Lucy，事后觉得像发出邀请
facts.anchor: he shouldn’t have told her that his name was Arthur

facts.fact: 邮差名叫 Greg，出自 Caroline 日记
facts.anchor: The postman’s name was Greg. Greg, from Caroline’s diaries.

facts.fact: 箱中网球从一只变成三只，多出两只崭新
facts.anchor: And there were two more beside it, both brand new

facts.fact: Caroline 日记写圣诞节不宜 Greg 和 Lucy 来访，山上雪大、路断数周
facts.anchor: Christmas isn’t a good time for Greg and Lucy to visit

facts.fact: 厨房架上只剩三只杯子，其余全部消失
facts.anchor: only three mugs left on the shelf

facts.fact: Arthur 日记末页写 Caroline 在电线里
他回屋锁门，坐在黑暗中听电塔的声音
facts.anchor: He went back into the house, and locked and bolted the door
